chunks: "Charity is not sold until it is apportioned."

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةُ: charity property, here referring to alms-related wealth

ai.seo_question: Can charity property be sold before it is apportioned?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning ṣadaqah property, prohibiting its sale before it has been properly determined or apportioned. It relates to the orderly administration of charitable wealth within Islamic law.
